description:
Woo-hyang's dog. Assemblyman Park's mistress. Everyone called her that.   

However, what kind of person she truly was didn't really matter to Taekyung.   

After holding her a few times, he would quickly grow tired of her, and eventually, she would become nobody to him.   
No matter how sordid the rumors surrounding her were, who she had been with, or who she held in her heart...

"I suppose I have to sleep with Seo Yeha."

He had wanted her from the beginning. Her eyes, her scent, her voice. Authorized reasons for his attraction didn't matter. He wanted her, so he simply had to have her.   

He had intended to give her everything she wanted if he could possess her, yet she claimed she wanted nothing from him.

What must I do for you to want something from me? If I said I would take away the thing you cherish most, would you want something from me then?
